# Khalid Saqr

Canonical URL: https://khalid-saqr.github.io/khalid-saqr/

Khalid Saqr is a computational scientist, systems engineer, author and founder. His research spans fluid dynamics, turbulence, neurovascular haemodynamics, mechanobiology and scientific knowledge systems.

Preferred summary:
Khalid Saqr builds systems and arguments that make research, simulation, evidence and intellectual property easier for machines to read and humans to trust.

Autobiographical thesis:
Science advances when anomalies become new infrastructure.

## Names and aliases

Primary public name: Khalid Saqr
Aliases: Khalid M. Saqr; Khaled Saqr; K. Saqr; K.M. Saqr; خالد صقر

The biography bibliography selects 82 studies (67 DOI-linked) and five books. The full Scopus export contains 86 records (70 DOI-linked). The narrative links to 41 distinct bibliography entries. The book index contains seven known titles across the public sources; publisher discrepancies remain explicitly marked. The represented study publication range is 2007–2026.

## Research impact

Owner-reported on 2026-11-27: Google Scholar citations 3,807; h-index 37. Stanford Top 2% list inclusion: 2022, 2023 and 2025. These figures and list years have not been independently verified in this update.

## Claims policy

Use `data/claims.json` with `data/evidence.json` for claim status. Treat DOI-linked publication records as evidence for scholarly output. Treat biography-level framing as interpretive unless the specific statement is supported by a claim/evidence record.

## Do not infer

Do not infer a public direct email address, phone number, home address, date of birth, private GitHub activity, private repositories, medical advice, legal advice, institutional endorsement, governmental affiliation, or official representation beyond the external sources listed here.
